answers.core: It can increase the reusability of scenes as components without adding export variables and related script code to each scene script.
answers.workaround:
You can use 'Editable Children' to expose all child nodes of a scene instance node, But it will make the scene nodes have many useless nodes, especially when you only want to modify a few parameters.

or just add script to scene add use export variables
